_why: The ledger's `redaction` column used to be computed from whether .fixer/SXXr.result.json existed. .fixer/ is gitignored (.gitignore:103), so the column read 8/52 in a worktree that held those artefacts and 0/52 everywhere else, including CI. `ledger.py --check` could therefore never pass in CI, and the ledger reported a number that depended on untracked state. That is the dead-measure failure mode LEDGER_NOTES warns about, inside the campaign's own instrument.
_contract: A slug belongs here when its redaction round was applied and verified. ledger.py reads this list and still requires the committed prose report to show run_on_sentences <= 12, so the evidence is committed on both halves. Add a slug in the same commit that lands its round. numbering_epoch names the numbering the slugs were checked against; tools/fixer/numbering.py refuses a list that carries another epoch or a slug the epoch does not number.
_recorded: 2026-10-03, from the .fixer/SXXr.result.json artefacts present in the campaign worktree at commit 8b0e112a. Two junk tags produced by earlier runs, S112 and S67, are not sections and are excluded.
_rekeyed: 2026-10-13: the list was keyed by tag (S01, S03, ...). Each tag is now the slug of its number under numbering_epoch 52 (audit/fixer/numbering_epoch.json). The section index of each file equalled its position at the recorded commit, so no number moved.
